email.body1:
Andrew, saw Prove launched its unified Identity Platform in April as the trust layer for an agentic world.

A launch that broad usually puts more in-market accounts in play than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline quietly leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Andrew, quick follow-up for Prove.

After a platform launch, technical demand spikes faster than a team can qualify it by hand, so most groups cannot say how many meetings they actually need to hit target. The gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Andrew, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B platforms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
